claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings are NECESSARY and SUFFICIENT for three non-jurist-preference views at characterized minimal scales: (1) Citation Heritage (21yr/137k, cp64 AUC 0.77-0.85 > TF-IDF 0.71-0.74), (2) Section Cross-Lingual (1K sample, Sachverhalt 0.282 > 0.2, Dispositiv 0.150 > 0.1, Erwaegungen 0.094 < 0.1 FAIL), (3) Linear Hybrid Complement (19yr/122k, w=0.3-0.4 PASS adversarial, JP 0.61-0.67 < TF-IDF 0.78-0.79). TF-IDF citation hybrids = PRIMARY product mode (jurist preference, branch clustering). Two-mode tradeoff fundamental and irreducible. True OOS JuristPref ceiling ~0.53 < 0.7 factory target.

citation_heritage.verdict: Dense superior to TF-IDF citation baseline at all scales >=21yr

linear_hybrid_22yr.verdict: Hybrids PASS adversarial at w=0.3-0.4 but JP below TF-IDF baseline

two_mode_tradeoff.verdict: No single representation dominates all three metrics

tfidf_174k_primary.verdict: TF-IDF beats semantic baseline (0.43) at full scale

data_blockers.note: 2022-2023 embeddings EXIST and PASS citation heritage quality check
